title: Sources: OpenEvidence, an AI search engine for doctors, raised $250M at a $15B valuation, up from $12B in January; it could be open to selling itself (Katie Roof/Business Insider)
summary: Katie Roof / Business Insider: Sources: OpenEvidence, an AI search engine for doctors, raised $250M at a $15B valuation, up from $12B in January; it could be open to selling itself — OpenEvidence, an AI search engine for doctors, is the latest AI darling to raise back-to-back funding rounds.
